csv_project_name: AE for Mooresville Architectural & Civil/ Design Svc
csv_scope_of_work: The Town of Mooresville (the Town) is requesting a Statement of Qualifications (SOQ) for professional consulting firms to provide On-Call Architectural and Civil/ Design Services on an as-needed basis for current and upcoming Town projects. Projects vary in complexity and scope (see Scope of Services). The Town is seeking to pre-qualify firms whose combination of experience and personnel will provide timely, cost-effective, and high-quality professional services. Pre-qualified firms will then be eligible to enter into project-specific agreements for services to be provided on an as-needed basis as determined by the Town. Full-service (turnkey) Architectural and Civil design services Programming and space needs assessments Due diligence, design development, and construction documents Preparation of phase-based deliverables, including programming reports, design packages, design development documents, construction documents, and record drawings, as applicable Cost estimating and value engineering Project planning, including budget development, cost control, and schedule development Bidding and procurement support, including preparation of bid documents, responses to inquiries, and evaluation of bids as needed Construction administration (CA) services, including site observations, submittal review, and coordination with contractors Evaluation and documentation of change orders, substitutions, and field directives Contract and document review Preparation of technical reports, studies, and supporting documentation
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Cost Estimating, Value Engineering, Planning/Master Planning, Sanitation Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Utility Engineering, Traffic Design Engineering

title: AE for Mooresville Architectural & Civil Design Services
short_description: On-call architectural and civil design services for various Town of Mooresville projects.
project_scope: On-call, as-needed professional consulting services for current and upcoming Town of Mooresville projects. The scope covers projects of varying complexity and size and includes full-service architectural and civil design, programming and space needs assessments, due diligence, design development, construction documents, phase-based deliverables, record drawings, cost estimating, value engineering, budget and schedule development, bidding support, construction administration, change order evaluation, technical reports, and supporting studies. No specific building, bridge, span, floor area, or construction volume is defined because this is a pre-qualification framework for multiple future projects.
services: Pre-qualification of firms for project-specific agreements for architecture, civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, construction/project management, cost estimating, value engineering, planning/master planning, sanitation engineering, mechanical engineering, structural engineering, utility engineering, and traffic design engineering; including programming, design development, construction documents, procurement support, and construction administration.
relevance_explanation:
- This is an on-call framework for multiple unspecified future projects rather than a defined structure.
- The notice is broad and general, with no identified bridge, long-span roof, stadium, or special structure.
- Framework agreements without technical specification are generally low priority for sbp.
- Structural engineering is listed among many disciplines, but there is no clear focus on demanding structural design.
- Could contain occasional building-related opportunities, but current information is too unspecific for strategic prioritization.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated. The notice is a pre-qualification for on-call services covering multiple future projects of varying scope and complexity, so no realistic project-specific construction cost can be derived from the available information.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated. Because this is an on-call pre-qualification with future project-specific agreements and no defined project scope, a realistic sbp fee estimate is not possible from the available information.
references_qualifications: The Town seeks to pre-qualify firms based on a combination of relevant experience and personnel capable of providing timely, cost-effective, and high-quality professional services. Specific minimum reference counts or project thresholds are not stated in the provided text.
award_criteria: Not specified in the provided text.
contracting_authority: Town of Mooresville, Mooresville, North Carolina, USA. Contact: Scott Hager. Phone: 704-663-3800. Fax: 704-663-7832. Email: mhager@mooresvillenc.gov. Website: https://procurement.opengov.com/portal/mooresvillenc/projects/261268
notes: Framework/on-call solicitation with renewable term. Base period: 36 months; renewal option: 24 months. Questions deadline: 2026-05-15 05:00 PM EDT. Although structural engineering is included, the tender is primarily a general municipal architectural/civil services pool and not a defined technically specific project.
